ns2:section.sectionText: "Note: Must be junior standing or higher. Introduces electro-acoustic music, including historical background, music literature, sound synthesis, analog/digital recording and mixing, signal processing techniques, and compositional application in the areas of musique concrete, electronic music, and Musical Instrument Digital Interface (MIDI) technology as applied to electro-acoustic concert art music. Weekly lab times are assigned. Students pursuing the BA Music Technology Option should take MUS 209 in the spring of their sophomore year prior to taking MUS 407."
